name: May 2026 Core Update
description: Strengthened Google Information Gain patents (US 11,562,019 B2). Demoted commodity content lacking empirical testing, primary-source data, or original benchmarks.

name: FAQ Rich Result Retirement
description: Discontinued FAQ rich snippets globally for commercial websites. Recommended migration to TechArticle and QAPage for genuine community forums.

name: Site Reputation Abuse Enforcement
description: Enforced manual and algorithmic penalties on third-party commercial content hosted on trusted domains without direct first-party editorial involvement.

name: August 2024 Core Update
description: Refined helpful content signals into core ranking systems, rewarding independent creator content with authentic user experience signals.

name: Interaction to Next Paint (INP) Launch
description: Officially replaced First Input Delay (FID) with INP as a primary Core Web Vital. Target set to under 200ms at 75th percentile.
